_about: The Living Server switches every release world ships with (owner 2026-11-16: "all our living server features should be in by default if someone downloads our installer"). build_release_037.py writes each into the world's ServerProperty row as both Value and DefaultValue (the server's own mark of an untouched default, so a later changed default still reaches it), whatever the developer's install had, and checks it. A key without a row gets the server's code default at the first start, which test_release_server_settings.py checks is the same value. KeptOff says why each switch that ships off is off.
